seo.title: Services: Custom Software, AI-Native Apps, Automation, IoT & Websites | Samvay360
seo.description: Samvay360 builds custom software and ERP, AI-native apps, business automations, IoT systems and websites around how your business already works. Based in Gujarat, India, working with businesses anywhere.

hero.title: Five ways we turn how you work into software.
hero.description: Each project starts with how your team works today. We pick the right mix from the list below, show you a working demo, and keep improving it after launch.

services.name: Custom Software
services.tagline: ERP and business systems shaped around your process.
services.summary: For businesses that have outgrown Excel, WhatsApp groups and paper registers. We build the screens, steps and reports your team already thinks in.
points: ERP modules for orders, purchase, production, stock, dispatch and accounts
Inventory and dispatch tracking with barcode labels and scanning
Role-based access for owners, supervisors and staff
Web apps, mobile apps and admin panels

images.alt: Stock and dispatch dashboard built for an aluminium factory

services.name: AI-Native Apps
services.tagline: Apps where AI does the core work.
services.summary: Software designed around what AI is good at: reading documents, understanding questions and drafting replies. Your team checks the result instead of typing it.
points: Bills, challans and invoices read from a photo into the system
Assistants that answer questions from your own records
Plain-language search across files, orders and chats
AI drafts for quotes, replies and reports, approved by a person

services.name: Automations
services.tagline: The follow-ups nobody has to remember.
services.summary: If a task only happens because someone remembers it, the system can do it instead: approvals, reminders, updates and reports.
points: WhatsApp and email alerts when an order, payment or stock level changes
Approval steps that move on their own
Daily and weekly reports sent automatically
Data kept in sync between the tools you already use

services.name: IoT + Software
services.tagline: Machines and sensors you can see on your phone.
services.summary: We connect devices and sensors to a dashboard and app, so you see what is happening on the floor without walking to it. IoT is where we started: our first builds were a home security camera and a hands-free remote.
points: Live machine and sensor readings on a dashboard
Alerts when a value goes out of range
Camera and security systems connected to an app
Hardware prototypes with the software to run them

services.name: Websites
services.tagline: Fast, custom websites that bring in enquiries.
services.summary: For manufacturers, traders and service businesses that need to look credible online. Often the first step before something bigger.
points: Custom design built around your products and services
Catalogues, brochure downloads and enquiry forms that reach you on WhatsApp or email
Fast on mobile and set up for Google search
Changes and updates after launch

faq.q: What is the difference between custom software and a ready-made ERP?
faq.a: A ready-made ERP gives every business the same screens and steps. Custom software is built around your own process, so your team keeps working the way it already does, and you only pay for the parts you use.

An app where AI does part of the core work, such as reading a bill, answering a question from your records or drafting a quote, and a person checks the result. We show it working on your own data in the demo before you decide.

faq.q: What kind of tasks can you automate?
faq.a: Anything that follows a rule and relies on someone remembering it: reminders, approvals, WhatsApp or email alerts, status updates and regular reports.

faq.q: Can you connect our machines or sensors to software?
faq.a: Yes. We connect devices and sensors to a dashboard and app, with alerts when something needs attention. Tell us what equipment you have and we will suggest how to connect it.

faq.q: Do we have to replace the tools we already use?
faq.a: No. We can connect to what you already have, or replace one piece at a time.
Tell us how the work flows today. We listen, show you a working demo built around your process, and you trial it before committing.
